relations.evidence: śrī 2 bhūpālendramallasya sāmrājye, śrī keśavacandra kṛtayārāvatamahāvihārāvasthita, ṅataḍholake, mārga pūrvabhāge, gṛhavāsinā, śrī sūryyacandrabhiunā likhitaiyāpustīti

date.as_written: nepālasmin rudravasubhiḥ vaiśāṣakṛṣṇapakṣeaṣṭamyāṃtithau śatavṛṣa nakṣetre vaidhatiyoge ādityavāsare

place.as_written: śrī keśavacandra kṛtayārāvatamahāvihārāvasthita, ṅataḍholake, mārga pūrvabhāge

notes: The date is expressed by chronogram: rudra (11) and vasu (8) = NS 811. The scribe's title appears corrupted as 'bhiunā' for 'bhikṣuṇā'. Keśavacandra is the legendary founder of the vihāra (Ituṃ Bāhā) and is part of the monastery's name.
